crossCardObservation.what: PARCEL-C-REPORT's own parcelRecordFactRead.ts (merged just before this card, same store, structurally similar per-parcel read pattern -- confirmed by reading its file header) claims 'structurally read-only by construction' but, unlike this card's parcelRecordCellRead.ts, does not call `SET default_transaction_read_only = on` on its pool. Its actual mechanism is 'the code never builds anything but a SELECT' plus 'no read-only DB role exists' -- a real, code-level constraint, but a CONVENTION, not the same protocol-level, Postgres-enforced guarantee this card's reader carries. Both modules' own comments use the word 'structurally' to describe two genuinely different strengths of guarantee.

Named as an observation, not a blocker.
